questions.question:
A school collects money on three days: Monday £80, Tuesday £120, Wednesday £100.
Its target is £350. Which statement is correct?
options: It needs £50 more to reach the target.
Monday raised more money than Tuesday.
It has already exceeded the target by £50.
Wednesday raised half as much as Monday.
questions.explanation: Toplam 80+120+100=300 sterlin toplanmıştır. 350 sterlinlik hedef için 50 sterlin daha gerekir.
